parsed.notes: Only a redlined excerpt of the conformed agreement (Annex A to Amendment No. 2, dated November 2, 2026) was provided; the EBITDA, Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio and Consolidated Interest Expense Ratio definitions, Section 11.1 (amendments/voting), guarantor release provisions and investment covenants were not included, so EBITDA add-backs and the LME-protection terms could not be verified. The leverage grid in the redline is garbled by PDF extraction. The best reading of the post-Amendment No. 2 grid is: 4.25x for 6/30/24-12/31/25; 5.25x for 3/31/26 through 3/31/27; 5.00x for 6/30/27-9/30/27; 4.75x for 12/31/27-3/31/28; 4.50x for 6/30/28-9/30/28; and 4.25x from 12/31/28 onward. The 5.25x level may end at 12/31/26, with 3/31/27 at 5.00x; confirm against the clean conformed copy. Acquisition holiday: for fiscal quarters ending on or after March 31, 2029 (previously December 31, 2027), a permitted acquisition with consideration over $100M lets leverage rise to 4.75x for four quarters (an Elevated Ratio Period), and there must be at least one compliant 4.25x quarter between Elevated Ratio Periods. Amendment No. 2 also: extends the 'Specified Period' (covenant relief period) to end on delivery of a compliance certificate for the quarter ending December 31, 2028 (previously September 30, 2027); cuts the Inside Maturity Indebtedness basket from the greater of $700M and 40% of EBITDA to $0 after the Amendment No. 2 Effective Date, except for the Rabobank Delayed Draw Incremental Term Loan under the 2025 Incremental Facility Amendment; removes the ability to incur Incremental Term Facilities and 8.2(e) debt as inside-maturity debt; adds EU CRD VI lending-office provisions; and carries a 0.10% consent fee. Amendment No. 1 (Feb 26, 2026) had earlier introduced covenant relief. The facilities are secured, with a Collateral/Covenant Release Date concept, and pari passu with the senior secured notes under an intercreditor agreement. Incremental capacity is the greater of $1.75B and 100% of EBITDA, plus unlimited amounts subject to 3.50x Consolidated Senior Secured Leverage Ratio pro forma. Unsecured debt under 8.2(d) is unlimited subject to Pro Forma Compliance with the financial covenants.
parsed.facility: Multi-currency Revolving Credit Facility (L/C-BA sublimit $125M), Revolving Euro Tranche and Revolving Yen Tranche facilities, Term A-1, A-2, A-3, A-5 and A-6 term loans, and a €200M Euro Term Loan, plus a Rabobank delayed-draw incremental term loan (2025); sizes of the other tranches and maturities are not stated in the excerpt.

terms.summary: No provision restricting transfers or exclusive licensing of material IP to unrestricted subsidiaries appears in the provided text. The agreement appears to be an investment-grade-style bank deal without an unrestricted subsidiary framework.

The provided excerpt contains no requirement for affected-lender consent to subordination of the loans or liens. Section 11.1 (Amendments and Waivers) was not included, so this could not be confirmed.

No provision prevents release of a guarantor merely because it ceases to be wholly owned. Subsidiaries less than 90% owned are Excluded Subsidiaries, and the release provisions (7.9/10.9) were not provided.
No unrestricted subsidiary designation mechanism or cap appears in the provided text. Investments in Immaterial Subsidiaries are capped at $10M, but that is not an unrestricted subsidiary cap.
The EBITDA definition was not included in the excerpt, and no cap on cost-savings, synergy or restructuring add-backs was identified.
No equity cure right for the financial covenants appears in the provided text.
